name: ikits_p1_factory
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/ikits_p1_factory; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme factory --out $O --tex 512 --ao 4 --only Stub_A,Stub_B,Scrap,Castings,Ingots,SlagCart,Barrels,Crates,Drum,Weeds,Rock_A,Rock_B,Tree_A,Tree_B,Foundry,Gasholder,HammerShed,WaterTower,Workshop,Hammer,BeamEngine,Crane --shots $O/shots --each > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
rm -f $O/kit_hi.blend; ls -la $O $O/shots
